title: Getting started with ggsegverse
text: ecosystem ships four atlases box: dk() (Desikan-Killiany cortical parcellation), aseg() (FreeSurfer subcortical segmentation), tracula() (white matter tracts), suit() (cerebellar lobules). accessed function calls return atlas objects. cortical surface plot uses geom_brain(): Desikan-Killiany atlas rendered ggseg’s default settings. subcortical segmentation works way: FreeSurfer’s automatic subcortical segmentation atlas.
code: ggplot() +   geom_brain(atlas = dk(), show.legend = FALSE) ggplot() +   geom_brain(atlas = aseg(), show.legend = FALSE)

title: Getting started with ggsegverse

what: Quick instructions for AI coding agents working on ggsegverse
title: Quick instructions for AI coding agents working on ggsegverse
text: Purpose: help AI get productive quickly outlining project’s shape, important files, build/test workflows, repo-specific conventions. ggsegverse tidyverse-style meta-package installs loads ggseg brain visualization ecosystem library(ggsegverse). contain plotting code — orchestrates loading core packages: ggseg.formats, ggseg, ggseg3d, ggseg.meshes, ggplot2. Scope plotting: users load ggsegverse make brain figures. Atlas-building tools (ggseg.extra) deliberately core; users install separately creating atlases. design mirrors tidyverse package works: attach core packages, report versions, detect conflicts. ggseg.formats — atlas data structures S3 classes (foundation). ggseg — 2D ggplot2 brain region plotting via geom_brain(). ggseg3d — interactive 3D brain visualization. ggseg.meshes — additional cortical cerebellar surface meshes. ggplot2 — plotting grammar ggseg builds ; attached theme(), scales, labs() work without extra library(). ggseg packages live ggsegverse GitHub org distributed https://ggsegverse.r-universe.dev. ggplot2 comes CRAN. core_package_sources() R/utils.R single source truth: named vector mapping core package source ("ggsegverse" "cran"), drives version checks install refs. DESCRIPTION — lists core packages Imports. R/attach.R — attachment logic: core_unloaded(), same_library(), ggsegverse_attach(), startup message formatting. R/zzz.R — .onAttach() hook; respects ggsegverse.quiet option suppresses messages testthat runs. R/conflicts.R — ggsegverse_conflicts() detects name clashes involving ggseg packages. Re-exports identical object (e.g. ggseg::dk re-exporting ggseg.formats::dk) conflicts. R/update.R — ggsegverse_update(), ggsegverse_deps(), ggsegverse_sitrep() checking installed vs available versions (GitHub main DESCRIPTION ggsegverse packages, CRAN rest). R/atlases.R — atlas discovery installation ggsegverse r-universe. R/utils.R — core_package_sources() (core package list), ggsegverse_packages(), shared helpers like installed_version(). R/ggsegverse-package.R — package-level docs ignore_unused_imports() satisfy R CMD check. Update docs changing roxygen: devtools::document() Run full package checks: devtools::check() Run unit tests: devtools::test() Load interactive testing: devtools::load_all() ggsegverse_packages() — character vector core package names. ggsegverse_conflicts() — detect masked functions. ggsegverse_update() — check outdated packages. ggsegverse_deps() — data frame local vs available versions. ggsegverse_sitrep() — diagnostic overview. ggseg_atlas_repos() — list atlas packages r-universe. install_ggseg_atlas() / install_ggseg_atlas_all() — install atlas packages. installed_ggseg_atlases() — list installed atlas packages. print.ggsegverse_conflicts / format.ggsegverse_conflicts — S3 methods conflict display. Tidyverse coding style; use |> pipe existing code . roxygen2 documentation; NAMESPACE auto-generated. code comments except explaining necessary workarounds. Self-explanatory function variable naming. Tests use testthat describe()/() structure. Adding new core package: add DESCRIPTION Imports, add source core_package_sources() R/utils.R, add reference ignore_unused_imports() R/ggsegverse-package.R. test fails core package missing Imports. Add new core package DESCRIPTION Imports. Add package source core_package_sources() R/utils.R. Add one exported symbol reference ignore_unused_imports(). Run devtools::document() devtools::check().
